design_overview: RetailSync is a mobile-first PWA built for fast, one-handed use on the shop floor. Clerks get a camera-first scan flow, managers get alerts and reorder tools, and owners get dashboards and team controls. Role-aware bottom navigation keeps each role to its permitted screens.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Give owners and managers a live overview of stock value, low-stock counts, top sellers and recent stock movements.

key_components.name: Dashboard Header
key_components.styling: Deep blue gradient header with greeting 'Good morning, Dana', store name, and a live 'Synced' green dot.
key_components.interaction: Bell icon opens Low-Stock Alerts screen.

key_components.name: Stock Value Card
key_components.styling: White rounded card with large '$128,450' total stock value, '+2.4% this week' in green, and a small sparkline.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens Reports screen.

key_components.name: Low-Stock Count Card
key_components.styling: Amber-tinted card showing '12 items low' with a count badge and a 'Review' link.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens Low-Stock Alerts screen.

key_components.name: Out-of-Stock Card
key_components.styling: Red-tinted card beside Low-Stock, showing '3 out of stock' with a bold number.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens Low-Stock Alerts filtered to out of stock.

key_components.name: Top Sellers List
key_components.styling: Card list of 5 rows with product thumbnail, name, units sold, and a rank number. Dividers are subtle.
key_components.interaction: Tap a row opens Product Detail.

key_components.name: Live Activity Feed
key_components.styling: Rows such as 'Sam sold 2 x Oat Milk, now 14', each with a timestamp. New rows highlight briefly.
key_components.interaction: Tap a row opens Product Detail.

key_components.name: Quick Scan FAB
key_components.styling: Circular primary-blue floating button above the nav bar, white search icon and 'Scan' label, soft shadow.
key_components.interaction: Opens Scan and Lookup screen.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White bar with 5 icon-and-label tabs; active tab is blue with a pill indicator.
key_components.interaction: Tap switches between main screens.

screens.user_flow: Entered after login or from any bottom tab. Leads to Product Detail, Low-Stock Alerts, Reports or Scan.

screens.name: Scan and Lookup
screens.purpose: Scan barcodes by camera or handheld scanner to look up products, receive deliveries, or create unknown products.

key_components.name: Scan Top Bar
key_components.styling: Dark translucent bar titled 'Scan Item' with a back arrow and a 'Camera / Scanner' toggle.
key_components.interaction: Toggle switches camera or handheld input; back returns to Dashboard.

key_components.name: Camera Viewfinder
key_components.styling: Full-width live camera preview with a rounded teal corner frame, an animated scan line and hint 'Align barcode within frame'.
key_components.interaction: Detected barcode opens the result card within 1 second.

key_components.name: Mode Segmented Control
key_components.styling: Pill segmented control with 'Look Up' and 'Receive Delivery'. Active segment is filled blue with white text.
key_components.interaction: Switches scan mode; Receive mode adds each scan to a batch.

key_components.name: Manual Barcode Input
key_components.styling: Rounded 48px input with placeholder 'Type or paste barcode' and a blue 'Find' button.
key_components.interaction: Submit looks up the product and shows the result card.

key_components.name: Product Result Card
key_components.styling: Bottom sheet with product photo, name, SKU, big '24 in stock' badge and a green 'In stock' chip.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens Product Detail and Adjust Stock screen.

key_components.name: Add to Stock Stepper
key_components.styling: Quantity stepper with large minus and plus buttons and a numeric field, shown in Receive mode.
key_components.interaction: Adjusts the quantity to receive for the scanned item.

key_components.name: Unknown Barcode Prompt
key_components.styling: Rounded modal reading 'Barcode not found', with primary 'Create New Product' and secondary 'Rescan' buttons.
key_components.interaction: Create opens a new product form; Rescan closes the modal.

key_components.name: Confirm Receipt Button
key_components.styling: Full-width primary blue button 'Confirm Received (6 items)' with a teal count badge.
key_components.interaction: Adds scanned stock, shows success toast, returns to Dashboard.

screens.user_flow: Reached from the Scan tab or FAB. Leads to Product Detail for a known item, a create-product form for an unknown one, or back to Dashboard after receiving.

screens.name: Product Detail and Adjust Stock
screens.purpose: Show live stock and history for a product, adjust quantity with a reason code, and set its reorder threshold.

key_components.name: Product Header
key_components.styling: White top bar with back arrow, title 'Oat Milk 1L', and an edit icon on the right.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to previous screen; edit opens product fields.

key_components.name: Product Hero Card
key_components.styling: Rounded card with product photo, SKU 'OM-1001', supplier name, price, and shelf location chip 'Aisle 4'.
key_components.interaction: Tap photo enlarges the image.

key_components.name: Live Stock Counter
key_components.styling: Large '24' quantity in bold blue, 'On hand' label and a pulsing 'Live' chip. Turns amber when below threshold.
key_components.interaction: Updates in place when another device changes stock.

key_components.name: Adjustment Stepper
key_components.styling: Large minus and plus buttons around a numeric input with placeholder 'Enter quantity change'.
key_components.interaction: Sets the quantity change before saving.

key_components.name: Reason Code Selector
key_components.styling: Dropdown with placeholder 'Select reason', options: Damaged, Lost, Received, Sold, Correction. Required marker shown.
key_components.interaction: Opens reason list; selection enables the Save button.

key_components.name: Reorder Threshold Input
key_components.styling: Labeled number field 'Alert me below' with placeholder '5' and a helper line about manager alerts.
key_components.interaction: Saves threshold used for low-stock alerts.

key_components.name: Save Adjustment Button
key_components.styling: Full-width blue gradient button 'Save Adjustment', disabled grey until reason selected.
key_components.interaction: Logs user, time and reason; shows success toast and updates count.

key_components.name: Movement History List
key_components.styling: Timeline rows with +/- quantity in green or red, reason, user name, and relative timestamp.
key_components.interaction: Tap row expands details inline.

screens.user_flow: Opened from a scan result, Dashboard list or alert item. Save returns to the previous screen with confirmation.

screens.name: Low-Stock Alerts
screens.purpose: Let managers review items below threshold, select them and generate a draft purchase order per supplier.

key_components.name: Alerts Header
key_components.styling: White header titled 'Low Stock' with count badge '12' and a filter icon on the right.
key_components.interaction: Filter opens supplier and severity options.

key_components.name: Severity Filter Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal rounded chips 'All', 'Low', 'Out of stock'; the active chip is filled blue.
key_components.interaction: Filters the alert list by severity.

key_components.name: Low-Stock Item Card
key_components.styling: Selectable row card with checkbox, thumbnail, name, red '3 left' chip and 'Threshold 5' caption.
key_components.interaction: Checkbox selects item; tapping the card opens Product Detail.

key_components.name: Supplier Group Header
key_components.styling: Grey section label such as 'FreshDairy Co. (4 items)' with a 'Select all' text link.
key_components.interaction: Select all checks every item for that supplier.

key_components.name: Set Thresholds Link
key_components.styling: Secondary outlined button 'Edit Thresholds' with a settings icon, placed under the list heading.
key_components.interaction: Opens per-product threshold editing, as in Product Detail.

key_components.name: Create Purchase Order Bar
key_components.styling: Sticky full-width blue button 'Create Purchase Order (4)' above the nav bar; hidden until items are selected.
key_components.interaction: Opens the draft purchase order modal.

key_components.name: Draft Purchase Order Modal
key_components.styling: Full-height sheet with supplier name, editable quantity rows, total cost, and 'Save Draft' primary and 'Cancel' secondary buttons.
key_components.interaction: Save Draft creates the order and shows a success toast.

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Shown when no alerts: soft green circle, heading 'All stocked up', text 'No items below threshold'.
key_components.interaction: None; informational only.

screens.user_flow: Reached from the Alerts tab, the Dashboard card or a push notification. Ends on a draft order confirmation, then back to the list.

screens.name: Reports and Export
screens.purpose: Let owners review stock value, turnover and movement history for a date range and export it to CSV.

key_components.name: Reports Header
key_components.styling: White header titled 'Reports' with a share icon on the right.
key_components.interaction: Share opens export options for the current range.

key_components.name: Date Range Picker
key_components.styling: Rounded field showing 'Oct 1 - Oct 31' with a calendar-style chevron and quick chips 7D, 30D, 90D.
key_components.interaction: Opens a calendar sheet to pick start and end dates.

key_components.name: Stock Value Trend Chart
key_components.styling: Card with a smooth blue line chart of stock value over time, labeled axes and a tooltip on touch.
key_components.interaction: Touch a point to see the value for that day.

key_components.name: KPI Row
key_components.styling: Three compact tiles: 'Stock Value', 'Turnover 4.2x', 'Low Items 12', each with a bold figure.
key_components.interaction: Tap a tile to filter the report below.

key_components.name: Top Sellers Bar List
key_components.styling: Rows with product name, horizontal teal bars proportional to units sold, and unit counts at right.
key_components.interaction: Tap a row opens Product Detail.

key_components.name: Movement History Table
key_components.styling: Scrollable rows with date, product, +/- quantity colored green or red, reason and user.
key_components.interaction: Tap a row opens Product Detail.

key_components.name: Export CSV Button
key_components.styling: Full-width primary button 'Export CSV' with a share icon, sticky above the nav bar.
key_components.interaction: Downloads the CSV; shows a progress bar then 'Export ready' toast.

screens.user_flow: Reached from the Reports tab or the Dashboard stock value card. Export downloads a file and keeps the user on this screen.

screens.name: Team and Roles
screens.purpose: Let owners create staff accounts, assign roles and deactivate users, with access denied for clerks.

key_components.name: Team Header
key_components.styling: White header titled 'Team' with a plus icon button on the right.
key_components.interaction: Plus opens the Add Staff form sheet.

key_components.name: Staff Search Input
key_components.styling: Rounded search field with placeholder 'Search staff by name or email'.
key_components.interaction: Filters the staff list as you type.

key_components.name: Staff Member Card
key_components.styling: Row card with avatar, name, email, a role chip 'Store Clerk' in blue, and a green 'Active' status dot.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens edit sheet for role and status.

key_components.name: Add Staff Form
key_components.styling: Bottom sheet with inputs 'Full name', 'Email address', 'Temporary password', and a primary 'Create Account' button.
key_components.interaction: Create Account saves the user and closes the sheet.

key_components.name: Role Selector
key_components.styling: Three radio cards: 'Store Owner', 'Store Manager', 'Store Clerk', each with a one-line permission summary.
key_components.interaction: Selecting a card sets the permissions for the account.

key_components.name: Active Toggle
key_components.styling: Switch labeled 'Account active'; turns grey when off, with red helper text 'User can no longer sign in'.
key_components.interaction: Toggling opens a confirmation, then deactivates or reactivates the user.

key_components.name: Deactivate Confirmation
key_components.styling: Centered dialog 'Deactivate Sam?' with red 'Deactivate' primary and grey 'Cancel' button.
key_components.interaction: Confirm blocks login and logs future attempts; Cancel closes dialog.

key_components.name: Access Denied State
key_components.styling: Shown to clerks: lock-style panel with 'Admin access required' and a 'Back to Dashboard' outlined button.
key_components.interaction: Returns the clerk to the Dashboard.

screens.user_flow: Reached from the Team tab by owners only; clerks see the access-denied state. Saving returns to the staff list.

ui_components.name: Primary Button
ui_components.styling: 52px tall, 12px radius, blue gradient, white bold label; disabled state is grey.
ui_components.interaction: Triggers the main screen action with a press scale.

ui_components.name: Secondary Button
ui_components.styling: Outlined with a 1.5px blue border, blue label, white fill, 12px radius.
ui_components.interaction: Triggers an alternative or cancel action.

ui_components.name: Text Input
ui_components.styling: 48px height, 12px radius, light grey border, blue focus ring, grey placeholder text.
ui_components.interaction: Focus shows the keyboard and the focus ring.

ui_components.name: Info Card
ui_components.styling: White surface, 16px radius, subtle 1px border and soft shadow, 16px padding.
ui_components.interaction: Tap navigates to the related detail screen.

ui_components.name: Stock Status Chip
ui_components.styling: Pill chip: green 'In stock', amber 'Low', red 'Out'; tinted background with bold text.

ui_components.name: Top App Bar
ui_components.styling: 56px bar with back arrow, bold title, and a single action icon on the right.
ui_components.interaction: Back returns; action icon performs a screen action.

ui_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
ui_components.styling: 64px white bar, 5 tabs with icon and label; active tab blue.

ui_components.name: Bottom Sheet
ui_components.styling: White sheet with 24px top radius, drag handle and dimmed backdrop.
ui_components.interaction: Swipe down or tap the backdrop to dismiss.

ui_components.name: Toast Message
ui_components.styling: Dark rounded snackbar with white text and a colored status stripe; auto-dismisses.
ui_components.interaction: Appears after saves and disappears after 3 seconds.

ui_components.name: List Row
ui_components.styling: 64px row with thumbnail, two text lines, right-aligned value and a chevron.
ui_components.interaction: Tap opens the related detail screen.

responsive_design: Mobile-first from 360px wide. Cards stack in one column on phones, two columns on tablets, and the bottom nav becomes a left rail at 1024px and up. Touch targets are at least 48px.
accessibility: WCAG AA contrast, 48px touch targets, visible focus rings, text labels beside icons, status never shown by color alone, screen-reader labels on scan and stock changes, and a live-region announcement for stock updates.
animations: Scan line loops at 1.5s. Live stock counts crossfade over 200ms when updated. Sheets slide up in 250ms. Buttons scale to 0.97 on press. Toasts fade in and out. Reduced-motion setting is respected.
icons: Only the approved outline icon set: home, search, user, settings, bell, bookmark, heart, filter, plus, edit, trash, share. 24px size, 2px stroke, always paired with labels. Search doubles as the scan action.
